## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with new character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, conversations with humans, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected key game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, conversations with humans, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected key game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected key game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

535: export function combinedMods(state) {
536:   const m = { growth: 0, faithPerAeon: 0, powerPerAeon: 0, wisdomPerAeon: 0, influencePerAeon: 0, miracleBonus: 0, smiteBonus: 0, relicBonus: 0, relicDiscount: 0, apEvery3: false };
537:   const add = mods => { if (!mods) return; for (const k of Object.keys(mods)) { if (k === 'apEvery3') m.apEvery3 = m.apEvery3 || !!mods[k]; else m[k] = (m[k] || 0) + mods[k]; } };
538:   add(domainOf(state.god.domain).mods);
539:   add(lineageOf(state.god.lineage).mods);
540:   for (const r of state.races || []) add(r.mods);
541:   return m;

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected key game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected key game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected key game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected key game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected key game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected key game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected key game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected key game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected key game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected key game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected key game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.

- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

### Completed

### Active

- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.

- No implementation changes have been made yet.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected key game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected relevant game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected relevant game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected relevant game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected relevant game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected relevant game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.
- A search command failed because `rg` is unavailable; `grep` worked.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and offspring that persist.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.
- A search command failed because `rg` is unavailable; `grep` worked.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.
- A search command failed because `rg` is unavailable; `grep` worked.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.
- A search command failed because `rg` is unavailable; `grep` worked.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- `newGame` initializes state in `data.js`; `renderVillage`, save/load, and modal interactions are in `game.js`.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.
- A search command failed because `rg` is unavailable; `grep` worked.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- `newGame` initializes state in `data.js`; `renderVillage`, save/load, and modal interactions are in `game.js`.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- `newGame` initializes state in `data.js`; `renderVillage`, save/load, and modal interactions are in `game.js`.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant game files and integration points.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, events, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action/event handling, village, relationships, saves, and rendering.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- `newGame` initializes state in `data.js`; `renderVillage`, save/load, and modal interactions are in `game.js`.
- Children and battles currently appear only as event flavor; there is no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant game mechanics, creator UI, portrait rendering, village, social interactions, and screenshot entry point.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, aeon mechanics, and game data.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, actions, village, Olympus relationships, rendering, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- `newGame` initializes state in `data.js`; `renderVillage`, save/load, and modal interactions are in `game.js`.
- Olympus visits and relationship interactions already exist; children and battles currently appear only as event flavor, with no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant game mechanics, creator UI, portrait rendering, village, social interactions, and screenshot entry point.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, aeon mechanics, and game data.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, actions, village, Olympus relationships, rendering, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- `newGame` initializes state in `data.js`; `renderVillage`, save/load, and modal interactions are in `game.js`.
- Olympus visits and relationship interactions already exist; children and battles currently appear only as event flavor, with no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with character customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected relevant game mechanics, creator UI, portrait rendering, village, social interactions, and screenshot entry point.
- Verified the baseline in Playwright and saved `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Implement cohesive character-creation, gameplay, and world-building enhancements.
- Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add masculine face and facial-hair options, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
2. Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
3. Run and verify the updated game and UI in a browser.
4. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, aeon mechanics, and game data.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, actions, village, Olympus relationships, rendering, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.
- `/tmp/opencode/godspire-baseline.jpg`: Verified 1280×900 JPEG baseline screenshot.

## Important Context
- GODSPIRE is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a village view, rival relationships, hair customization, and local saves.
- `newGame` initializes state in `data.js`; `renderVillage`, save/load, and modal interactions are in `game.js`.
- Olympus visits and relationship interactions already exist; children and battles currently appear only as event flavor, with no persistent offspring or combat system.
- The village is currently a settlement illustration with follower-based stages; it has no human dialogue system.
- No implementation changes have been made yet.
