603: export function performAction(state, actionId, rng = Math.random) {
604:   const action = ACTIONS.find(a => a.id === actionId);
605:   if (!action) return { ok: false, error: 'Unknown action.' };
606:   if (!canAfford(state, action)) return { ok: false, error: missingReason(state, action) || 'Not enough resources.' };
607:   if (action.special === 'race') return { ok: false, error: 'Choose a race in the forge.' };
608: 
609:   state.ap -= action.ap;
610:   for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(action.cost || {})) {
611:     if (k === 'faith' || k === 'power') state.stats[k] = Math.max(0, state.stats[k] - v);
612:   }
613:   if (action.special === 'relic') {
614:     const relic = makeRelic(state, rng);
615:     state.relics.push(relic);
616:     return { ok: true, text: `You take a piece of the world and make it holy. The ${relic.name} is born.`, relic, changes: {} };
617:   }
618:   const result = action.run(state, rng);
619:   const changes = applyChanges(state, result.changes);
620:   return { ok: true, text: result.text, changes };
621: }
622: 
623: export function makeRivals(rng = Math.random) {
624:   const pool = [...RIVAL_POOL];
625:   for (let i = pool.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1)); [pool[i], pool[j]] = [pool[j], pool[i]]; }
626:   const picks = pool.slice(0, 24);
627:   const rivals = picks.map((g, i) => {
628:     const base = 43000 * Math.pow(0.9, i) * (0.86 + rng() * 0.3);
629:     return {
630:       ...g,
631:       id: 'rival-' + i,
632:       might: Math.round(base),
633:       growth: 0.006 + rng() * 0.013,
634:       prevMight: Math.round(base),
635:     };
636:   });
637:   return rivals.sort((a, b) => b.might - a.might);
638: }
639: 
640: export function newGame(draft, rng = Math.random) {
641:   const starter = raceOf(draft.race);
642:   const trait = traitOf(starter.trait);
643:   const state = {
644:     version: 1,
645:     god: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(draft)),
646:     stats: { faith: 16, power: 12, wisdom: 10, influence: 8 },
647:     followers: 420,
648:     aeon: 1,
649:     age: AGE_START,
650:     ap: 3,
651:     rank: 0,
652:     relics: [],
653:     relationships: [],
654:     salonPurchases: [],
655:     attractiveStick: false,
656:     races: [{ id: starter.id, name: starter.name, glyph: starter.glyph, color: starter.color, form: starter.form, ears: starter.ears, trait: trait.id, traitName: trait.name, mods: { ...trait.mods }, custom: false }],
657:     log: [],
658:     seenEvents: [],
659:     rivals: makeRivals(rng),
660:     lastRanks: {},
661:     victory: false,
662:   };
663:   state.ap = apMax(state);
664:   addLog(state, 'star4',
665:     'You wake in the space between prayers. The mortal world is small, loud, and entirely yours to shape.',
666:     'divine',
667:     'Despiertas en el espacio entre plegarias. El mundo mortal es pequeño, ruidoso y completamente tuyo para moldearlo.');
668:   addLog(state, 'users',
669:     `The ${starter.name} are the first to speak your name. ${starter.desc}`,
670:     'faith',
671:     `Los ${starter.name} son los primeros en pronunciar tu nombre. ${starter.descEs || starter.desc}`);
672:   return state;
673: }
674: 
675: export function addLog(state, icon, text, tone = '', textEs = '') {
676:   state.log.push({ aeon: state.aeon, icon, text, textEs, tone, at: Date.now() });
677:   if (state.log.length > 90) state.log.splice(0, state.log.length - 90);
678: }
679: 
680: export function passiveTick(state, rng = Math.random) {
681:   const m = combinedMods(state);
682:   const rank = state.rank || 0;
683:   const faithBase = state.stats.faith;
684:   const influenceBase = state.stats.influence;
685:   const followersGain = Math.round((6 + faithBase * 0.55 + influenceBase * 0.9) * (1 + m.growth + rank * 0.06));
686:   const gains = {
687:     followers: followersGain,
688:     faith: 1 + Math.round(m.faithPerAeon),
689:     power: 1 + Math.round(m.powerPerAeon),
690:     wisdom: 1 + Math.round(m.wisdomPerAeon),
691:     influence: 1 + Math.round(m.influencePerAeon),
692:   };
693:   state.followers += gains.followers;
694:   state.stats.faith += gains.faith;
695:   state.stats.power += gains.power;
696:   state.stats.wisdom += gains.wisdom;
697:   state.stats.influence += gains.influence;
698: 
699:   const surges = [];
700:   for (const r of state.rivals) {
701:     r.prevMight = r.might;
702:     r.might = Math.round(r.might * (1 + r.growth + (rng() - 0.5) * 0.004) + 20);
703:   }
704:   if (rng() < 0.55) {
705:     const r = state.rivals[Math.floor(rng() * state.rivals.length)];
706:     const boost = 1.02 + rng() * 0.04;
707:     r.might = Math.round(r.might * boost);
708:     surges.push({
709:       rival: r,
710:       text: `Cults of ${r.name} swell in the night. Their might rises sharply.`,
711:       textEs: `Los cultos de ${r.name} crecen en la noche. Su poder se dispara.`,
712:     });
713:   }
714:   return { gains, surges };
715: }
716: 
717: export function rankMap(state) {
718:   const all = [...state.rivals.map(r => ({ key: r.name, might: r.might })), { key: 'YOU', might: computeMight(state) }];
719:   all.sort((a, b) => b.might - a.might);
720:   const map = {};
721:   all.forEach((e, i) => { map[e.key] = i + 1; });
722:   return map;
723: }
724: 
725: export function standing(state) {
726:   const might = computeMight(state);
727:   const above = state.rivals.filter(r => r.might > might).length;
728:   return { might, rank: above + 1, total: state.rivals.length + 1 };
729: }
730: 
731: export function canAscend(state) {
732:   return state.rank < RANKS.length - 1 && computeMight(state) >= RANKS[state.rank + 1].need;
733: }
734: 
735: export function ascend(state) {
736:   if (!canAscend(state)) return null;
737:   const from = RANKS[state.rank];
738:   state.rank += 1;
739:   const to = RANKS[state.rank];
740:   const beforeMight = computeMight(state);
741:   state.followers = Math.round(state.followers * 1.12);
742:   state.stats.faith += 10;
743:   state.stats.power += 6;
744:   state.stats.wisdom += 6;
745:   state.stats.influence += 4;
746:   state.ap = apMax(state);
747:   addLog(state, 'crown',
748:     `You ascend from ${from.name} to ${to.name}. The heavens rearrange themselves around your throne.`,
749:     'rank',
750:     `Asciendes de ${from.name} a ${to.name}. Los cielos se reorganizan alrededor de tu trono.`);
751:   return { from, to, afterMight: computeMight(state), gainedMight: computeMight(state) - beforeMight };
752: }
753: 
754: export function applyEventChoice(state, choice) {
755:   const changes = applyChanges(state, choice.effects || {});
756:   let relic = null;
757:   if (choice.effects && choice.effects.relic) {
758:     relic = makeRelic(state);
759:     state.relics.push(relic);
760:   }
761:   return { changes, relic, result: choice.result };
762: }
763: 
764: export function pickEvent(state, rng = Math.random) {
765:   let pool = EVENTS.filter(e => !state.seenEvents.includes(e.id));
766:   if (!pool.length) pool = FALLBACK_EVENTS.slice();
767:   const ev = pool[Math.floor(rng() * pool.length)];
768:   const rival = state.rivals[Math.floor(rng() * state.rivals.length)];
769:   const clone = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(ev));
770:   const swap = str => (str || '').replace(/\{rival\}/g, rival ? rival.name : 'a rival god');
771:   clone.title = swap(clone.title);
772:   clone.text = swap(clone.text);
773:   clone.rivalName = rival ? rival.name : 'a rival god';
774:   clone.choices = clone.choices.map(c => ({ ...c, result: swap(c.result) }));
775:   if (!state.seenEvents.includes(ev.id)) state.seenEvents.push(ev.id);
776:   return clone;
777: }
778: 
779: export function endAeon(state, rng = Math.random) {
780:   const before = rankMap(state);
781:   const currentAge = Number.isFinite(state.age) && state.age >= AGE_START
782:     ? state.age
783:     : AGE_START + Math.max(0, (state.aeon || 1) - 1) * AGE_PER_AEON;
784:   const { gains, surges } = passiveTick(state, rng);
785:   state.aeon += 1;
786:   state.age = currentAge + AGE_PER_AEON;
787:   state.ap = apMax(state);
788:   state.lastRanks = before;
789:   const text = `The world turns. ${fmt(gains.followers)} souls join your flock, and devotion gathers in the dark.`;
790:   const textEs = `El mundo gira. ${fmt(gains.followers)} almas se unen a tu rebaño, y la devoción se reúne en la oscuridad.`;
791:   addLog(state, 'sun', text, 'faith', textEs);
792:   for (const s of surges) addLog(state, 'crown', s.text, 'rival', s.textEs);
793:   const milestone = AGE_MILESTONES[state.age];
794:   if (milestone) addLog(state, 'hourglass', milestone.en, 'divine', milestone.es);
795:   return { gains, surges, event: rng() < 0.72 ? pickEvent(state, rng) : null };
796: }

## GODSPIRE code map

The project is a zero-build vanilla ES-module browser game. The main flow is in `game.js`; game data and DOM-independent mechanics are in `data.js`.

### Screens, creator, and portraits

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html:18,55,130` defines the title, creator, and game screens. The creator mounts include `#creatorPortrait`, `#creatorTabs`, and `#creatorPanels` (`:72,111,119`); the game UI includes `#relationshipBox` (`:181`). It loads `game.js` as a module (`:245`).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:251–268` renders the title portrait and decides whether to show Continue based on whether a save key exists.
- Creator rendering and interaction are in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:270–433`: `renderPreview`, `renderPanel`, `updateDraft`, and `bindCreator`. The editor covers appearance, domain, lineage, and starter race. `beginGame` at `:435–444` fills blank fields, creates the initial state, saves it, and enters the game.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/portrait.js:60` exports `renderPortrait`, used for creator previews, the title portrait, the in-game portrait, and the HUD avatar. `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/rival-portrait.js:4` exports the separate `rivalPortrait` renderer for rival gods.

### Game flow and mechanics

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:495–611` contains `renderGame` and `renderVillage`. The game view renders rank, might, followers, stats, races, relics, relationships, actions, log, and leaderboard. The village illustration changes at 1,500 and 5,000 followers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:707–797` binds gameplay controls. Actions call `performAction`; ending an aeon calls `endAeon` and may open an omen. Ascension is handled through `ascend`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/data.js:3–13` defines nine ranks. Core mechanics include `apMax` (`:544`), `computeMight` (`:551`), `canAfford` (`:577`), `performAction` (`:603`), and `newGame` (`:640`).
- `newGame` initializes the player with 420 followers, three actions, starting stats, a starter race, and generated rivals. `endAeon` (`data.js:779–796`) applies passive gains, advances age and action points, updates rivals, and has a 72% chance to return an event.
- The Genesis Forge is in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:1109–1203`. It allows up to four races; creating one costs two actions, 30 faith, and 12 power, and immediately increases followers by 18%.

### Events and relationships

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:827–860` renders omen choices and applies the selected choice through `applyEventChoice`. Event selection and effects are in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/data.js:754–777`.
- Relationship and Olympus UI are in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:613–623,919–990`. First meetings add 8 affection; sharing ambrosia costs 8 faith for 12 affection; gifting a laurel costs 6 power for 10 affection. The summary card displays the relationship with the highest affection.
- Localization is handled in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/i18n.js`. Some social-modal copy is hardcoded English in `game.js` (notably `openRelationshipBox`, `openOlympus`, and `openGodMeeting`), so those screens may not be fully localized.

### Persistence and practical caveats

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:15` defines the save key, `godspire.save.v1`. `saveGame` and `loadSaved` are at `:460–479`; rendering also saves state at `:584`.
- Loading checks for a god and numeric follower count, then supplies compatibility defaults for fields such as relationships, age, and salon purchases. Storage and parse errors are silently caught. The title’s Continue visibility only checks whether a save value exists; `continueGame` performs the actual load validation (`game.js:1240–1249`).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md:11` recommends serving `index.html` through a static server or using `./start.sh`. The script at `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh:4` requires `RUNTIME_DIR` and invokes its `scripts/default-start.mjs`; it is not a self-contained generic launcher.
- No project test manifest, matching test files/build configuration, or `.github/workflows/` files were found. `data.js` is the natural location for isolated mechanics tests because it contains no DOM code.

No files were modified.

514: export function roman(n) {
515:   const table = [[1000,'M'],[900,'CM'],[500,'D'],[400,'CD'],[100,'C'],[90,'XC'],[50,'L'],[40,'XL'],[10,'X'],[9,'IX'],[5,'V'],[4,'IV'],[1,'I']];
516:   let out = '';
517:   for (const [v, s] of table) while (n >= v) { out += s; n -= v; }
518:   return out || 'I';
519: }

521: export function fmt(n) {
522:   n = Math.round(n);
523:   if (n >= 1e9) return (n / 1e9).toFixed(n >= 1e10 ? 0 : 1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'B';
524:   if (n >= 1e6) return (n / 1e6).toFixed(n >= 1e7 ? 1 : 2).replace(/\.0+$/, '') + 'M';
525:   if (n >= 1e4) return (n / 1e3).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'K';

527:   return String(n);

535: export function combinedMods(state) {
536:   const m = { growth: 0, faithPerAeon: 0, powerPerAeon: 0, wisdomPerAeon: 0, influencePerAeon: 0, miracleBonus: 0, smiteBonus: 0, relicBonus: 0, relicDiscount: 0, apEvery3: false };
537:   const add = mods => { if (!mods) return; for (const k of Object.keys(mods)) { if (k === 'apEvery3') m.apEvery3 = m.apEvery3 || !!mods[k]; else m[k] = (m[k] || 0) + mods[k]; } };
538:   add(domainOf(state.god.domain).mods);
539:   add(lineageOf(state.god.lineage).mods);
540:   for (const r of state.races || []) add(r.mods);
541:   return m;
542: }

545:   const rank = state.rank || 0;
546:   let ap = 3 + (rank >= 3 ? 1 : 0) + (rank >= 6 ? 1 : 0);
547:   if (combinedMods(state).apEvery3 && (state.aeon || 1) % 3 === 0) ap += 1;
548:   return ap;

551: export function computeMight(state) {
552:   const f = Math.pow(Math.max(0, state.followers), 0.72) * 6;
553:   const stats = state.stats;
554:   const relicMight = (state.relics || []).reduce((a, r) => a + r.power, 0);
555:   const rank = state.rank || 0;
556:   const rankBonus = rank * 400 + rank * rank * 180;
557:   return Math.round(f + stats.faith * 18 + stats.wisdom * 18 + stats.power * 16 + stats.influence * 14 + relicMight + rankBonus);
558: }

560: export function applyChanges(state, c = {}) {
561:   const before = state.followers;
562:   let f = before;
563:   if (c.followersFlat) f += c.followersFlat;
564:   if (c.followersPct) f *= (1 + c.followersPct);
565:   state.followers = Math.max(0, Math.round(f));
566:   const changes = { followers: state.followers - before };
567:   for (const k of ['faith', 'power', 'wisdom', 'influence']) {
568:     if (c[k]) {
569:       const old = state.stats[k];
570:       state.stats[k] = Math.max(0, old + c[k]);
571:       changes[k] = state.stats[k] - old;
572:     }
573:   }
574:   return changes;
575: }

580:     if (k === 'faith' || k === 'power') { if (state.stats[k] < v) return false; }
581:   }
582:   return true;
583: }

593: export function makeRelic(state, rng = Math.random) {
594:   const m = combinedMods(state);
595:   const power = Math.round((260 + (state.rank || 0) * 150 + rng() * 180) * (1 + m.relicBonus));
596:   const es = state.locale === 'es';
597:   const prefixes = es ? RELIC_PREFIX_ES : RELIC_PREFIX;
598:   const nouns = es ? RELIC_NOUN_ES : RELIC_NOUN;
599:   const name = prefixes[Math.floor(rng() * prefixes.length)] + ' ' + nouns[Math.floor(rng() * nouns.length)];
600:   return { id: 'r' + Date.now() + Math.floor(rng() * 999), name, power };
601: }

603: export function performAction(state, actionId, rng = Math.random) {
604:   const action = ACTIONS.find(a => a.id === actionId);
605:   if (!action) return { ok: false, error: 'Unknown action.' };
606:   if (!canAfford(state, action)) return { ok: false, error: missingReason(state, action) || 'Not enough resources.' };
607:   if (action.special === 'race') return { ok: false, error: 'Choose a race in the forge.' };
608: 
609:   state.ap -= action.ap;
610:   for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(action.cost || {})) {
611:     if (k === 'faith' || k === 'power') state.stats[k] = Math.max(0, state.stats[k] - v);
612:   }
613:   if (action.special === 'relic') {
614:     const relic = makeRelic(state, rng);
615:     state.relics.push(relic);
616:     return { ok: true, text: `You take a piece of the world and make it holy. The ${relic.name} is born.`, relic, changes: {} };
617:   }
618:   const result = action.run(state, rng);
619:   const changes = applyChanges(state, result.changes);
620:   return { ok: true, text: result.text, changes };
621: }

623: export function makeRivals(rng = Math.random) {

625:   for (let i = pool.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1)); [pool[i], pool[j]] = [pool[j], pool[i]]; }
626:   const picks = pool.slice(0, 24);
627:   const rivals = picks.map((g, i) => {
628:     const base = 43000 * Math.pow(0.9, i) * (0.86 + rng() * 0.3);
629:     return {
630:       ...g,
631:       id: 'rival-' + i,
632:       might: Math.round(base),
633:       growth: 0.006 + rng() * 0.013,
634:       prevMight: Math.round(base),
635:     };
636:   });
637:   return rivals.sort((a, b) => b.might - a.might);
638: }
639: 
640: export function newGame(draft, rng = Math.random) {
641:   const starter = raceOf(draft.race);
642:   const trait = traitOf(starter.trait);
643:   const state = {
644:     version: 1,
645:     god: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(draft)),
646:     stats: { faith: 16, power: 12, wisdom: 10, influence: 8 },
647:     followers: 420,
648:     aeon: 1,
649:     age: AGE_START,
650:     ap: 3,
651:     rank: 0,
652:     relics: [],
653:     relationships: [],
654:     salonPurchases: [],
655:     attractiveStick: false,
656:     races: [{ id: starter.id, name: starter.name, glyph: starter.glyph, color: starter.color, form: starter.form, ears: starter.ears, trait: trait.id, traitName: trait.name, mods: { ...trait.mods }, custom: false }],
657:     log: [],
658:     seenEvents: [],
659:     rivals: makeRivals(rng),
660:     lastRanks: {},
661:     victory: false,
662:   };
663:   state.ap = apMax(state);
664:   addLog(state, 'star4',
665:     'You wake in the space between prayers. The mortal world is small, loud, and entirely yours to shape.',
666:     'divine',
667:     'Despiertas en el espacio entre plegarias. El mundo mortal es pequeño, ruidoso y completamente tuyo para moldearlo.');
668:   addLog(state, 'users',
669:     `The ${starter.name} are the first to speak your name. ${starter.desc}`,
670:     'faith',
671:     `Los ${starter.name} son los primeros en pronunciar tu nombre. ${starter.descEs || starter.desc}`);
672:   return state;
673: }
674: 
675: export function addLog(state, icon, text, tone = '', textEs = '') {
676:   state.log.push({ aeon: state.aeon, icon, text, textEs, tone, at: Date.now() });
677:   if (state.log.length > 90) state.log.splice(0, state.log.length - 90);
678: }
679: 
680: export function passiveTick(state, rng = Math.random) {
681:   const m = combinedMods(state);
682:   const rank = state.rank || 0;
683:   const faithBase = state.stats.faith;
684:   const influenceBase = state.stats.influence;
685:   const followersGain = Math.round((6 + faithBase * 0.55 + influenceBase * 0.9) * (1 + m.growth + rank * 0.06));
686:   const gains = {
687:     followers: followersGain,
688:     faith: 1 + Math.round(m.faithPerAeon),
689:     power: 1 + Math.round(m.powerPerAeon),
690:     wisdom: 1 + Math.round(m.wisdomPerAeon),
691:     influence: 1 + Math.round(m.influencePerAeon),
692:   };
693:   state.followers += gains.followers;
694:   state.stats.faith += gains.faith;
695:   state.stats.power += gains.power;
696:   state.stats.wisdom += gains.wisdom;
697:   state.stats.influence += gains.influence;
698: 
699:   const surges = [];
700:   for (const r of state.rivals) {
701:     r.prevMight = r.might;
702:     r.might = Math.round(r.might * (1 + r.growth + (rng() - 0.5) * 0.004) + 20);
703:   }
704:   if (rng() < 0.55) {
705:     const r = state.rivals[Math.floor(rng() * state.rivals.length)];
706:     const boost = 1.02 + rng() * 0.04;
707:     r.might = Math.round(r.might * boost);
708:     surges.push({
709:       rival: r,
710:       text: `Cults of ${r.name} swell in the night. Their might rises sharply.`,
711:       textEs: `Los cultos de ${r.name} crecen en la noche. Su poder se dispara.`,
712:     });
713:   }
714:   return { gains, surges };
715: }
716: 
717: export function rankMap(state) {
718:   const all = [...state.rivals.map(r => ({ key: r.name, might: r.might })), { key: 'YOU', might: computeMight(state) }];
719:   all.sort((a, b) => b.might - a.might);
720:   const map = {};
721:   all.forEach((e, i) => { map[e.key] = i + 1; });
722:   return map;
723: }
724: 
725: export function standing(state) {
726:   const might = computeMight(state);
727:   const above = state.rivals.filter(r => r.might > might).length;
728:   return { might, rank: above + 1, total: state.rivals.length + 1 };
729: }
730: 
731: export function canAscend(state) {
732:   return state.rank < RANKS.length - 1 && computeMight(state) >= RANKS[state.rank + 1].need;
733: }
734: 
735: export function ascend(state) {
736:   if (!canAscend(state)) return null;
737:   const from = RANKS[state.rank];
738:   state.rank += 1;
739:   const to = RANKS[state.rank];
740:   const beforeMight = computeMight(state);
741:   state.followers = Math.round(state.followers * 1.12);
742:   state.stats.faith += 10;
743:   state.stats.power += 6;
744:   state.stats.wisdom += 6;
745:   state.stats.influence += 4;
746:   state.ap = apMax(state);
747:   addLog(state, 'crown',
748:     `You ascend from ${from.name} to ${to.name}. The heavens rearrange themselves around your throne.`,
749:     'rank',
750:     `Asciendes de ${from.name} a ${to.name}. Los cielos se reorganizan alrededor de tu trono.`);
751:   return { from, to, afterMight: computeMight(state), gainedMight: computeMight(state) - beforeMight };
752: }
753: 
754: export function applyEventChoice(state, choice) {
755:   const changes = applyChanges(state, choice.effects || {});
756:   let relic = null;
757:   if (choice.effects && choice.effects.relic) {
758:     relic = makeRelic(state);
759:     state.relics.push(relic);
760:   }
761:   return { changes, relic, result: choice.result };
762: }
763: 
764: export function pickEvent(state, rng = Math.random) {
765:   let pool = EVENTS.filter(e => !state.seenEvents.includes(e.id));
766:   if (!pool.length) pool = FALLBACK_EVENTS.slice();
767:   const ev = pool[Math.floor(rng() * pool.length)];
768:   const rival = state.rivals[Math.floor(rng() * state.rivals.length)];
769:   const clone = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(ev));
770:   const swap = str => (str || '').replace(/\{rival\}/g, rival ? rival.name : 'a rival god');
771:   clone.title = swap(clone.title);
772:   clone.text = swap(clone.text);
773:   clone.rivalName = rival ? rival.name : 'a rival god';
774:   clone.choices = clone.choices.map(c => ({ ...c, result: swap(c.result) }));
775:   if (!state.seenEvents.includes(ev.id)) state.seenEvents.push(ev.id);
776:   return clone;
777: }
778: 
779: export function endAeon(state, rng = Math.random) {
780:   const before = rankMap(state);
781:   const currentAge = Number.isFinite(state.age) && state.age >= AGE_START
782:     ? state.age
783:     : AGE_START + Math.max(0, (state.aeon || 1) - 1) * AGE_PER_AEON;
784:   const { gains, surges } = passiveTick(state, rng);
785:   state.aeon += 1;
786:   state.age = currentAge + AGE_PER_AEON;
787:   state.ap = apMax(state);
788:   state.lastRanks = before;
789:   const text = `The world turns. ${fmt(gains.followers)} souls join your flock, and devotion gathers in the dark.`;
790:   const textEs = `El mundo gira. ${fmt(gains.followers)} almas se unen a tu rebaño, y la devoción se reúne en la oscuridad.`;
791:   addLog(state, 'sun', text, 'faith', textEs);
792:   for (const s of surges) addLog(state, 'crown', s.text, 'rival', s.textEs);
793:   const milestone = AGE_MILESTONES[state.age];
794:   if (milestone) addLog(state, 'hourglass', milestone.en, 'divine', milestone.es);
795:   return { gains, surges, event: rng() < 0.72 ? pickEvent(state, rng) : null };
796: }

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected existing game structure and relevant creator, portrait, gameplay, settlement, relationship, and save/load code.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handling, settlement rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot-capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture, relevant UI and mechanics, localization, save/load, and browser verification setup.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handling, settlement rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot-capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- `start.sh` requires `RUNTIME_DIR`; no test manifest or build configuration was found.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture, relevant UI and mechanics, localization, save/load, and browser verification setup.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handling, settlement rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot-capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- `start.sh` requires `RUNTIME_DIR`; no test manifest or build configuration was found.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected game architecture, UI, mechanics, localization, save/load, and browser verification setup.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handling, settlement rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot-capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- `start.sh` requires `RUNTIME_DIR`; no test manifest or build configuration was found.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

<subagent sessionID="ses_e2b8caadbffe9t1WcZSZmLiCdN" state="completed">
## Findings

**No files were changed.** The project has working general activities, Olympus relationships, a staged village illustration, and a god-appearance creator. Battles, human conversation, and persistent offspring are not implemented as dedicated systems; references to them are event or action narrative.

### Activities and battles

- **General actions are implemented.** The action definitions are in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/data.js:174–241`. Actions have AP and resource costs and apply stat, follower, or other changes. “Walk Among Mortals” costs 1 AP and 4 faith; its result is a short narrative and gains influence, followers, and wisdom (`data.js:227–231`). It does **not** open a conversation or track an encounter with a human.
- **Action execution is centralized.** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:707–728` handles clicks, affordability, dispatch to `performAction()`, logging, rendering, and notifications. `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/data.js:603–621` deducts costs and applies the action’s results.
- **Event choices are also implemented**, as discrete narrative choices with affordability checks and resource/stat effects. The UI is at `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:827–859`; choice effects are applied by `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/data.js:754–761`. Events are selected during end-of-aeon progression, with a 72% chance of an event (`data.js:779–795`).
- **There is no dedicated combat resolver or battle loop.** “Meet it in battle” appears as a choice in “The Wandering Titan” event, but resolves through ordinary power, influence, and follower changes plus narrative text (`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/data.js:439–445`). There are no combat rounds, units, battle state, or tactical decisions in that flow.

### Human conversations

- **No dedicated human-conversation system was found.** “Walk Among Mortals” describes meeting someone who shares bread, but the action resolves immediately as a stat change (`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/data.js:227–231`).
- Human-focused story beats, such as a dying child’s prayer or the birth of a prophesied child, are **event text and choices**, not persistent conversations or character interactions (`data.js:296–300`, `376–381`). The generic event UI applies the selected effects and logs the result; it does not create or retain a human character record (`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:827–859`).

### Olympus relationships

- **God-to-god relationships are implemented.** New games start with an empty `relationships` array (`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/data.js:640–672`). Relationship records are created when meeting a rival and contain `name`, `affection`, `met`, and `status` (`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:957–962`).
- The meeting modal provides a free introduction (+8 affection), sharing ambrosia (8 faith for +12), and gifting a laurel (6 power for +10); affection is capped at 100 and status is updated (`game.js:963–990`). The relationship box and Olympus list/selection are at `game.js:926–955`; the compact relationship summary is at `game.js:613–623`.
- **Persistence exists:** `saveGame()` serializes the whole state to local storage under the save key; loading defaults missing relationships to an empty array (`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:460–478`). The modals’ relationship mechanics work, but much of their copy and action text is hard-coded English rather than passed through the localization helper (`game.js:926–990`).

### Village visual and navigation

- **The village view is implemented as a fixed inline SVG scene**, not a live settlement simulation. `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:587–610` chooses one of three labels based on follower totals—humble settlement, growing village at 1,500 followers, and flourishing town at 5,000—and shows 4, 6, or 8 house illustrations. It also displays follower count, worshipping races, and the god’s domain.
- **Integration points are present in the UI:** the village-entry button, village panel, return button, and mobile Village tab are in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html:202–217,233–238`. `showGameSection()` switches realm/village views in `game.js:453–458`.
- **Village copy is localized** in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/i18n.js:577–589`. The scene itself is decorative and stage-based; it does not depict individual residents, buildings with distinct functions, or town activities.

### Persistent offspring

- **No persistent offspring system was found.** The new-game state has relationships, races, relics, logs, rivals, and progression fields, but no child or offspring collection (`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/data.js:640–662`). The save/load code serializes the state but does not add child-specific defaults or behavior (`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:460–478`).
- “A Child of Prophecy” offers narrative choices, but their effects modify ordinary resources and stats; no child entity is created or tracked (`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/data.js:376–381`). Other child references are also flavor text or event content.

### Appearance creator

- **A god-appearance creator exists**, separate from the village visual. Its panels let the player choose skin, face, complexion, markings, crown, build, eye shape/color/glow, hair style/color, plus domain and lineage (`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:316–367`). The randomizer updates appearance selections (`game.js:414–429`).
- Option values are defined in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/data.js:52–165`. The portrait renderer consumes appearance data and produces the god’s visual in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/portrait.js:60–88`.

**Bottom line:** To add human dialogue, a true battle system, or persistent offspring, those would require new gameplay/state models—not just new text or UI choices. Olympus relationships and the staged town view already have concrete integration points; the former is stateful, while the latter is primarily visual.
</subagent>

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture, UI, mechanics, localization, save/load, and browser verification setup.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handling, settlement rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot-capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- `start.sh` requires `RUNTIME_DIR`; no test manifest or build configuration was found.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.
- Key mechanics include `newGame`, `performAction`, `canAfford`, and `endAeon` in `data.js`; creator bindings and game UI are in `game.js`.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture, UI, mechanics, localization, save/load, and browser verification setup.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handling, settlement rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot-capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- General activities and god-to-god conversations exist; “Walk Among Mortals” currently has no dedicated human conversation or encounter tracking.
- Action execution is centralized in `performAction()` in `data.js` and the `#actionsGrid` click handler in `game.js`.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` has compatibility defaults for older saves.
- `start.sh` requires `RUNTIME_DIR`; no test manifest or build configuration was found.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture, UI, mechanics, localization, save/load, and browser verification setup.
- Confirmed actions run through `performAction()` in `data.js`, with the action grid handler in `game.js`.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handling, settlement rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot-capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.

- `start.sh` requires `RUNTIME_DIR`; no test manifest or build configuration was found.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture, UI, mechanics, localization, save/load, and browser verification setup.
- Confirmed actions run through `performAction()` in `data.js`, with the action grid handler in `game.js`.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handling, settlement rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot-capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- General activities and god-to-god conversations exist; “Walk Among Mortals” currently has no dedicated human conversation or encounter tracking.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` has compatibility defaults for older saves.
- `start.sh` requires `RUNTIME_DIR`; no test manifest or build configuration was found.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture, UI, mechanics, localization, save/load, and browser verification setup.
- Confirmed actions run through `performAction()` in `data.js`, with the action grid handler in `game.js`.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handling, settlement rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot-capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- General activities and god-to-god conversations exist; “Walk Among Mortals” currently has no dedicated human conversation or encounter tracking.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` has compatibility defaults for older saves.
- `start.sh` requires `RUNTIME_DIR`; no test manifest or build configuration was found.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture, UI, mechanics, localization, save/load, and browser verification setup.
- Confirmed actions run through `performAction()` in `data.js`, with the action grid handler in `game.js`.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handling, settlement rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot-capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- General activities and god-to-god conversations exist; “Walk Among Mortals” currently has no dedicated human conversation or encounter tracking.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` has compatibility defaults for older saves.
- `start.sh` requires `RUNTIME_DIR`; no test manifest or build configuration was found.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture, UI, mechanics, localization, save/load, and browser verification setup.
- Confirmed actions run through `performAction()` in `data.js`, with the action grid handler in `game.js`.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handling, settlement rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot-capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- General activities and god-to-god conversations exist; “Walk Among Mortals” currently has no dedicated human conversation or encounter tracking.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` has compatibility defaults for older saves.
- `start.sh` requires `RUNTIME_DIR`; no test manifest or build configuration was found.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture, UI, mechanics, localization, save/load, and browser verification setup.
- Confirmed actions run through `performAction()` in `data.js`, with the action grid handler in `game.js`.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handling, settlement rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot-capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- General activities and god-to-god conversations exist; “Walk Among Mortals” currently has no dedicated human conversation or encounter tracking.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` has compatibility defaults for older saves.
- `start.sh` requires `RUNTIME_DIR`; no test manifest or build configuration was found.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture, UI, mechanics, localization, save/load, and browser verification setup.
- Confirmed actions run through `performAction()` in `data.js`, with the action grid handler in `game.js`.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handling, settlement rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot-capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- General activities and god-to-god conversations exist; “Walk Among Mortals” currently has no dedicated human conversation or encounter tracking.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` has compatibility defaults for older saves.
- `start.sh` requires `RUNTIME_DIR`; no test manifest or build configuration was found.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture, UI, mechanics, localization, save/load, and browser verification setup.
- Confirmed actions run through `performAction()` in `data.js`, with the action grid handler in `game.js`.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handling, settlement rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot-capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- General activities and god-to-god conversations exist; “Walk Among Mortals” currently has no dedicated human conversation or encounter tracking.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` has compatibility defaults for older saves.
- `start.sh` requires `RUNTIME_DIR`; no test manifest or build configuration was found.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture, UI, mechanics, localization, save/load, and browser verification setup.
- Confirmed actions run through `performAction()` in `data.js`, with the action grid handler in `game.js`.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Run the game and verify UI and persistence in a browser.
- Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, and game mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handling, settlement rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG player portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot-capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- General activities and god-to-god conversations exist; “Walk Among Mortals” currently has no dedicated human conversation or encounter tracking.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` has compatibility defaults for older saves.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected game architecture and identified action mechanics, village rendering, relationship/Olympus modals, save/load, and appearance options.

### Active
- Implement requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Verify UI and persistence in a browser; save and inspect a JPEG screenshot at or below 1280px wide.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, action mechanics, and end-of-aeon progression.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handlers, village and Olympus rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG deity portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- General activities and god-to-god conversations exist; “Walk Among Mortals” currently has no dedicated human conversation or encounter tracking.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` provides compatibility defaults for older saves.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected game architecture and identified action mechanics, village rendering, relationship/Olympus modals, save/load, and appearance options.

### Active
- Implement requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Verify UI and persistence in a browser; save and inspect a JPEG screenshot at or below 1280px wide.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, action mechanics, and end-of-aeon progression.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handlers, village and Olympus rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG deity portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- General activities and god-to-god conversations exist; “Walk Among Mortals” currently has no dedicated human conversation or encounter tracking.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` provides compatibility defaults for older saves.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected game architecture and located action mechanics, village rendering, relationship/Olympus modals, save/load, and appearance options.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Verify UI and persistence in a browser; save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, actions, state creation, action mechanics, and end-of-aeon progression.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handlers, village and Olympus rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG deity portrait rendering.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- General activities and god-to-god conversations exist; “Walk Among Mortals” currently has no dedicated human conversation or encounter tracking.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` provides compatibility defaults for older saves.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Add activities and battles, human dialogue, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No additional decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the game architecture and located action mechanics, appearance options, village rendering, relationship/Olympus modals, save/load, and portrait rendering.

### Active
- Implement the requested customization, gameplay, world, and offspring features.
- Verify UI and persistence in a browser; save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features across the existing game.
2. Run the game and verify UI and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, action definitions/mechanics, initial state, and progression.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handlers, village and Olympus rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG deity portrait rendering and appearance support.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.

## Important Context
- The game is a vanilla ES-module browser game with existing actions/events, a settlement view, rival relationships, hair customization, Olympus visits, and local saves.
- Persistent offspring and a combat system are not implemented; battles and children currently appear only as event flavor.
- General activities and god-to-god conversations exist; “Walk Among Mortals” currently has no dedicated human conversation or encounter tracking.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` provides compatibility defaults for older saves.
- No implementation changes or verification have been recorded.
