## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions recorded yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected creator, portrait, action, settlement, relationship, save compatibility, HTML, and styling code; mapped feature integration points.
- Confirmed the game is served at `http://localhost:3000`; captured a baseline JPEG at `/tmp/opencode/godspire-before.jpg` (1280px wide).

### Active
- Implement requested features, including compatibility defaults for existing saves.
- Verify UI behavior and persistence in a browser; save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features.
2. Run the game and verify UI behavior and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, action definitions, initial state, and progression.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handlers, settlement and Olympus rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG deity portrait rendering and appearance support.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.

## Important Context
- No implementation changes have been made yet.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` supplies compatibility defaults for old saves.
- Creator customization is rendered in `renderPanel()`; actions execute through `#actionsGrid`; settlement rendering is in `renderVillage()`.
- `openRelationshipBox()` and `openOlympus()` handle relationship and Olympus UI; `performAction()` handles game actions.
- Settlement stages change at 1,500 and 5,000 followers; existing Olympus relationships exist, but no standalone combat or offspring state was found.
- Appearance options are defined in `data.js` around lines 111–165; creator defaults and controls are in `game.js` around lines 39–60 and 316–413; portrait clothing is hard-coded in `portrait.js` around lines 396–410.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions recorded yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected creator, portrait, action, settlement, relationship, save compatibility, HTML, and styling code; mapped feature integration points.
- Confirmed the game is served at `http://localhost:3000`; captured a baseline JPEG at `/tmp/opencode/godspire-before.jpg` (1280px wide).

### Active
- Implement requested features, including compatibility defaults for existing saves.
- Verify UI behavior and persistence in a browser; save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features.
2. Run the game and verify UI behavior and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, action definitions, initial state, and progression.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handlers, settlement and Olympus rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG deity portrait rendering and appearance support.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.

## Important Context
- No implementation changes have been made yet.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` supplies compatibility defaults for old saves.
- Creator customization is rendered in `renderPanel()`; actions execute through `#actionsGrid`; settlement rendering is in `renderVillage()`.
- `openRelationshipBox()` and `openOlympus()` handle relationship and Olympus UI; `performAction()` handles game actions.
- Settlement stages change at 1,500 and 5,000 followers; existing Olympus relationships exist, but no standalone combat or offspring state was found.
- Appearance options are defined in `data.js` around lines 111–165; creator defaults and controls are in `game.js` around lines 39–60 and 316–413; portrait clothing is hard-coded in `portrait.js` around lines 396–410.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions recorded yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped creator customization, action handling, village rendering, relationship/Olympus UI, and save compatibility.
- Confirmed the game is served at `http://localhost:3000`; captured baseline JPEG `/tmp/opencode/godspire-before.jpg` (1280px wide).

### Active
- Implement requested features, including compatibility defaults for existing saves.
- Verify UI behavior and persistence in a browser; save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features.
2. Run the game and verify UI behavior and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, action definitions, initial state, and progression.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handlers, village and Olympus rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG deity portrait rendering and appearance support.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.

## Important Context
- No implementation changes have been made yet.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` supplies compatibility defaults for old saves.
- Creator customization is rendered in `renderPanel()`; actions execute through `#actionsGrid`; village rendering is in `renderVillage()`.
- `openRelationshipBox()` and `openOlympus()` handle social UI; `performAction()` handles game actions.
- Village stages change at 1,500 and 5,000 followers; relationships already exist, but no standalone combat or offspring state was found.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped creator customization, action handling, village rendering, relationship/Olympus UI, and save compatibility.
- Confirmed the game is served at `http://localhost:3000`; captured baseline JPEG `/tmp/opencode/godspire-before.jpg` (1280px wide).

### Active
- Implement requested features, including compatibility defaults for existing saves.
- Verify UI behavior and persistence in a browser; save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested features.
2. Run the game and verify UI behavior and persistence.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options, action definitions, initial state, and progression.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, action handlers, village and Olympus rendering, relationships, and local saves.
- `portrait.js`: SVG deity portrait rendering and appearance support.
- `index.html`: Game screens and creator interface.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.

## Important Context
- No implementation changes have been made yet.
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` supplies compatibility defaults for old saves.
- Creator customization is rendered in `renderPanel()`; actions execute through `#actionsGrid`; village rendering is in `renderVillage()`.
- `openRelationshipBox()` and `openOlympus()` handle social UI; `performAction()` handles game actions.
- Village stages change at 1,500 and 5,000 followers; relationships already exist, but no standalone combat or offspring state was found.

Report changes.

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Include activities, battles, human conversations, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Activities and battles use the divine action economy; battles resolve with a power-based chance of success.
- A separate `activities.js` module handles activity UI and outcomes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added an Activities & battles entry point and `activities.js` with three activities and two risk-based battles; outcomes affect stats/followers and are recorded in the chronicle.
- Added English and Spanish UI labels for the activities entry point.
- Confirmed the game server at `http://localhost:3000` returns HTTP 200.
- `node --input-type=module --check < activities.js` completed without syntax errors.

### Active
- Deity appearance customization and portrait updates are being implemented.
- Olympus-inspired town visuals are being expanded.
- Human conversations and persistent offspring gameplay are being implemented.
- Browser verification, persistence testing, and updated JPEG capture/inspection remain pending.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Check and integrate the concurrent appearance, town, and social-gameplay changes.
2. Run the game in the browser; verify activities, battles, conversations, offspring persistence, and compatibility with existing saves.
3. Save and inspect an updated JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize implementation, verification, and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Game state initialization, actions, and mechanics.
- `game.js`: UI rendering, save/load, and event handlers.
- `activities.js`: New activity and battle gameplay.
- `index.html`: Game screens and feature entry points.
- `portrait.js`: Deity portrait rendering and appearance support.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.

## Important Context
- `newGame()` initializes state in `data.js`; `loadSaved()` in `game.js` supplies compatibility defaults for old saves.
- Local saves use `godspire.save.v1`.
- The game is available at `http://localhost:3000`.
- Baseline screenshot: `/tmp/opencode/godspire-before.jpg` (1280px wide); the requested updated screenshot has not yet been captured.
- Changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Expand GODSPIRE with deity customization, activities and battles, human conversations, an Olympus-inspired town, and persistent offspring.
- Verify and save the updated game, then inspect a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Add distinctive masculine deity faces, ancient Greek clothing, and Megara-inspired hairstyles.
- Include activities, battles, human conversations, and persistent offspring.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them on completion.
- Screenshot must be JPEG and no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Activities and battles use the divine action economy; battles resolve with a power-based chance of success.
- A separate `activities.js` module handles activity UI and outcomes.
- Social progression centers on consenting adult relationships and persistent family state.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added three activities and two risk-based battles in `activities.js`; outcomes affect stats/followers and appear in the chronicle.
- Added an Activities & battles entry point and English/Spanish labels.
- Expanded the village with an Olympus-inspired temple, hillside homes, olive trees, paths, lighting, and follower-driven visual growth.
- Integrated `social.js` into the game lifecycle and village UI, including safe social-state initialization for older saves.
- Added village conversations, relationship progression, consenting adult partnerships, family creation, child care, and persistent offspring.
- Added appearance choices to creator selection/randomization and portrait rendering, including face shapes, Greek garments, beards, and Megaran hair.
- Browser-tested activities, battle wins/losses, conversations, family progression and persistence, old-save initialization, and village visuals; test passed with no browser errors.
- JavaScript syntax checks and `git diff --check` passed.
- Captured and inspected `/tmp/opencode/godspire-after.jpg`; it is JPEG, 1280×900.

### Active
- Browser-level verification of appearance selections and portrait rendering remains pending.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Browser-test appearance selection and confirm the portrait updates for face, clothing, beard, and Megaran hairstyle.
2. Summarize implementation, verification, and assumptions; note that changes remain uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `data.js`: Appearance options and game state/mechanics.
- `game.js`: Creator UI, appearance selection, save/load compatibility, and event handlers.
- `portrait.js`: Deity portrait rendering and appearance support.
- `activities.js`: Activity and battle gameplay.
- `social.js`: Conversations, relationships, offspring, and social UI.
- `index.html`: Game screens and feature entry points.
- `styles.css`: Game styling.
- `i18n.js`: English and Spanish localization.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local saves use `godspire.save.v1`; `loadSaved()` initializes missing social state for legacy saves.
- Screenshot: `/tmp/opencode/godspire-after.jpg`; baseline: `/tmp/opencode/godspire-before.jpg`.
- `package.json` is absent, so no package test suite was run.

playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up
  mousewheel <dx> <dy>        scroll mouse wheel

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element
  pdf                         save page as pdf

Tabs:
  tab-list                    list all tabs
  tab-new [url]               create a new tab
  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

Storage:
  state-load <filename>       loads browser storage (authentication) state from a file
  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file
  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)
  cookie-get <name>           get a specific cookie by name
  cookie-set <name> <value>   set a cookie with optional flags
  cookie-delete <name>        delete a specific cookie
  cookie-clear                clear all cookies
  localstorage-list           list all localstorage key-value pairs
  localstorage-get <key>      get a localstorage item by key
  localstorage-set <key> <value> set a localstorage item
  localstorage-delete <key>   delete a localstorage item
  localstorage-clear          clear all localstorage
  sessionstorage-list         list all sessionstorage key-value pairs
  sessionstorage-get <key>    get a sessionstorage item by key
  sessionstorage-set <key> <value> set a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-delete <key> delete a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-clear        clear all sessionstorage

Network:
  requests                    list all network requests since loading the page. each request is numbered for use with the `request` command.
  request <index>             show full details (headers, body, response) of a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-headers <index>     print only the request headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-body <index>        print only the request body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-headers <index>    print only the response headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-body <index>       print the response body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command. textual bodies are inlined; binary bodies are saved to a file and the path is printed.
  route <pattern>             mock network requests matching a url pattern
  route-list                  list all active network routes
  unroute [pattern]           remove routes matching a pattern (or all routes)
  network-state-set <state>   set the browser network state to online or offline

DevTools:
  console [min-level]         list console messages
  run-code [code]             run playwright code snippet
  recording-start             start recording user actions
  recording-stop              stop recording user actions and print them as playwright code
  tracing-start               start trace recording
  tracing-stop                stop trace recording
  video-start [filename]      start video recording
  video-stop                  stop video recording
  video-chapter <title>       add a chapter marker to the video recording
  video-show-actions          annotate subsequent cli/mcp actions on the page with a callout that names the action and highlights the target element
  video-hide-actions          stop annotating actions performed on the page
  show                        show playwright dashboard
  pause-at <location>         run the test up to a specific location and pause there
  resume                      resume the test execution
  step-over                   step over the next call in the test
  generate-locator <target>   generate a playwright locator for the given element
  highlight [target]          show (or with --hide, remove) a highlight overlay for an element; `--hide` without a target hides all page highlights.

Install:
  install                     initialize workspace
  install-browser [browser]   install browser

Browser sessions:
  list                        list browser sessions
  close-all                   close all browser sessions
  kill-all                    forcefully kill all browser sessions (for stale/zombie processes)

Global options:
  --help [command]            print help
  --json                      output response as JSON
  --raw                       output only the result value, without status and code
  --version                   print version
